arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "ENV_PROBE_BEGIN"
echo "IDENTITY=$(id -un)"
stat -c 'ENV_OWNER=%U:%G MODE=%a' /etc/lowcost-europa/lowcost-europa.env
echo "ENV_KEYS"
grep -E '^[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*=' /etc/lowcost-europa/lowcost-europa.env | cut -d= -f1 | sort
cd /srv/lowcost-europa
set -a
. /etc/lowcost-europa/lowcost-europa.env
set +a
echo "DB_CONFIG_PROPERTIES"
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import os
for k in ("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE","POSTGRES_HOST","POSTGRES_PORT","POSTGRES_DB","POSTGRES_USER"):
    v=os.environ.get(k)
    print(k,"SET="+str(v is not None),"NONEMPTY="+str(bool(v)),"HOST_IS_SOCKET="+str(bool(v and v.startswith("/"))) if k=="POSTGRES_HOST" else "")
print("PASSWORD_SET", bool(os.environ.get("POSTGRES_PASSWORD")))
PY
echo "SERVICE_ENVIRONMENT"
systemctl show lowcost-europa.service -p Environment -p EnvironmentFiles --no-pager | sed -E 's/(PASSWORD|TOKEN|KEY|SECRET)[^ ]*/REDACTED/g'
echo "ENV_PROBE_END"
